card.name: All-caps warning text on hypersensitivity reactions
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS boxed warning text about serious hypersensitivity reactions, mainly REQUIRE after 'REACTIONS MAY' and INCLUDING after 'EMERGENCY MEASURES,'. Also fires on USE inside DIFFUSE.

modes.label: REQUIRE after MAY
modes.description: The verb REQUIRE in capitalized text saying serious hypersensitivity reactions may require epinephrine treatment.
modes.example: SERIOUS ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY<< REQUIRE>> TREATMENT WITH EPINEPHR

modes.label: INCLUDING before supportive care
modes.description: The word INCLUDING after 'emergency measures,' listing oxygen and intravenous care.
modes.example: ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE TREATMENT WITH EPINEPHRINE AND OTHER EMERGENCY MEASURES,<< INCLUDING>> OXYGEN, INTRAVEN

modes.label: Inside DIFFUSE
modes.description: The USE part of DIFFUSE in capitalized pulmonary reaction text.

card.plain: It lights up on key words in capitalized allergic-reaction warnings, like 'may require' epinephrine and 'including' oxygen.
